title: 第1781章 群狼环伺第1780章 强行破阵女帝化形
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
秋狩秘境入口处。
这片原本荒凉开阔的峡谷，此刻已经被人山人海挤得水泄不通。
玄龙城各大世家、宗门势力的旌旗在风中猎猎作响。
空气中弥漫着一股凝重到让人喘不过气的焦躁感。
李家家主李冲天站在最前方，双目充血，浑身上下散发着属于空源境初期的狂暴罡风，将周围的碎石卷得四处飞飞射。
“聂城主！我李家大长老的魂灯碎了！进去探索的大半精锐更是连个火星都没剩下！”
李冲天盯着前方高台上的中年男子，声音如同滚滚闷雷，震得不少修为低微的修士耳膜生疼。
“这秋狩秘境里绝对出了大变故！今天你必须把这入口阵法打开，让我们进去看个究竟！”
站在李冲天身旁的，是王家的三位实权长老，以及几个附属家族的当家人。
这些人同样是面容扭曲，焦急万分。
他们家族留在祠堂里的本命魂灯，在几个时辰前就像是遭了瘟疫一样，成片成片地熄灭。
傻子都知道，秘境里面绝对是遇到了一场单方面的屠杀。
高台上，玄龙城城主聂雄风负手而立。
这位执掌玄龙城多年的顶尖强者，眉头紧锁，脸色同样阴沉似水。
“李家主，本座理解你的心情。但规矩就是规矩。”
聂雄风深吸一口气，声音洪亮地传遍全场。
“这八荒困天阵，乃是初代城主集结全城之力布下的上古结界。设定了一月之期，只要时间不到，哪怕是本座拼了这条老命，也无法在外面强行将其开启！”
聂雄风心里其实比谁都急。
他的宝贝女儿聂清秋也在里面，虽说城主府没有设魂灯的习惯，但他现在同样是两眼一抹黑。
“打不开？难道就让我们眼睁睁看着族中子弟在里面死绝吗？”

李冲天咬碎了牙齿，显然不想接受这个解释。
“这也不行那也不行，城主府莫不是故意设局坑杀我等家族子弟！”
一名王家长老阴阳怪气地拱起火来。
眼看场面的局势越来越僵，几方大势力的强者已经抽出了兵刃，隐隐有逼宫的架势。
嗡！
就在这剑拔弩张的关头，后方那道高达百丈、流转着淡金色符文的阵法光幕，突然发出一声低沉的嗡鸣。
原本坚不可摧的阵法表面，竟然泛起了一阵剧烈的水波纹涟漪。
“怎么回事？”
“阵法有动静了！难道时间提前结束了？”
峡谷内的数千道目光齐刷刷地投向光幕。
李冲天和聂雄风也是猛地转头，眼中满是错愕。
只见淡金色的符文犹如受到惊吓的游鱼般向两侧散开，一道高约一丈、边缘闪烁着幽光的空间裂缝，被硬生生地从内部撕裂开来。
紧接着。
一阵平稳的脚步声从裂缝中传出。
一名身穿玄黑长袍、面容冷峻的青年，不急不缓地从裂缝中迈步而出。
在青年的身侧，一左一右跟着两名容貌倾城、气质各异的绝色佳人。
左边的女子穿着水蓝色劲装，温婉动人；右边的女子一袭紫色贴身罗裙，妩媚妖娆，却又透着一股骨子里的尊贵。
正是苏铭，以及沈轻雪和聂清秋。
当三人双脚踏上峡谷地面的瞬间。
content_en:
The entrance to the Autumn Hunting Secret Realm.
This originally desolate and open canyon was now overcrowded with people.
The flags of the major families and sects in Xuanlong City were flapping in the wind.
There was a heavy and breathless anxiety in the air.
The head of the Li family, Li Chongtian, stood at the front, his eyes bloodshot, and his whole body exuded the violent wind that belonged to the early stage of the Kongyuan Realm, rolling up the surrounding rubble and flying in all directions.
"City Lord Nie! The soul lamp of my elder Li family is broken! Most of the elite who went in to explore didn't even have a single spark left!"
Li Chongtian stared at the middle-aged man on the high platform in front of him. His voice was like rolling thunder, which made many monks with low cultivation experience pain in their eardrums.
"A big change has definitely happened in this Qiu Shou secret realm! Today you must open the entrance formation and let us go in to see what happens!"
Standing next to Li Chongtian were the three powerful elders of the Wang family and the heads of several affiliated families.
These people also had distorted faces and were extremely anxious.
The natal soul lamps left by their family in the ancestral hall were extinguished in pieces as if struck by a plague a few hours ago.
Any fool knows that there is definitely a one-sided massacre in the secret realm.
On the high platform, Nie Xiongfeng, the lord of Xuanlong City, stood with his hands behind his back.
This top man who has been in charge of Xuanlong City for many years has his brows furrowed and his face is equally gloomy.
"Master Li, I understand your feelings. But rules are rules."
Nie Xiongfeng took a deep breath and his loud voice spread throughout the audience.
"This Eight Desolate Heavenly Formation is an ancient barrier set up by the first-generation city lord who gathered the power of the entire city. It is set to last for one month. As long as the time is not up, I will not be able to forcefully open it from outside, even if I risk my life!"
Nie Xiongfeng was actually more anxious than anyone else.
His precious daughter Nie Qingqiu was also inside. Although the city lord's mansion did not have the habit of setting up soul lanterns, he was still looking dark.
"Can't open it? Are we just going to watch the clan members die inside?"
Li Chongtian gritted his teeth, obviously not wanting to accept this explanation.
"This won't work, and that won't work either. Could it be that the City Lord's Mansion deliberately set up a trap to kill us and other family members!"
One of the royal elders got angry and angry.
Seeing that the situation was becoming more and more tense, the powerful men from several major forces had already drawn their weapons, and seemed to be threatening to force them into submission.
Buzz!
At this tense moment, the hundred-foot-high formation light curtain behind them, with pale golden runes flowing around it, suddenly let out a low buzz.
A violent ripple of water appeared on the surface of the originally indestructible formation.
"What's going on?"
"There is movement in the formation! Has the time ended early?"
Thousands of eyes in the canyon all turned toward the light curtain.
Li Chongtian and Nie Xiongfeng also turned their heads suddenly, their eyes full of astonishment.
The pale golden runes spread out to both sides like frightened fish, and a space crack about one foot high with a faint light shining at the edge was torn open from the inside.
Immediately afterwards.
A steady sound of footsteps came from the crack.
A young man wearing a black robe and a stern face stepped out of the crack in a hurry.
Beside the young man, there were two stunning beauties with stunning looks and different temperaments, one on the left and one on the right.
The woman on the left is wearing aqua blue outfit, elegant and charming; the woman on the right is wearing a purple close-fitting skirt, charming and enchanting, but also showing nobility in her bones.
It was Su Ming, Shen Qingxue and Nie Qingqiu.
The moment the three of them stepped onto the canyon floor.
